title: 7.1 My Body
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Name the body in a clear head-to-feet order, then describe your own body.
grammar_function: A continuous head-to-toe sequence; This is my ... and I have two/ten ... with Sofía as the first-person speaker.
speaking_outcome: Name the body in a clear head-to-feet order, then describe your own body.
